title: Require reviewed logical authority and explicit uncertainty for every target query port

requirements.invariant: Every TQUERY is mapped only to behavior already supported by canonical product authority, confirmed decisions, reviewed capability evidence, or architecture; missing authority remains explicit instead of being inferred from source behavior or a port name.

This technical-control slice freezes one complete logical-authority registry over all generated target query methods without implementing a product query, physical data plane, provider adapter, or source-query reconciliation.

The registry records only inventory digest, globally deferred physical planes, and 18 closed-schema rows containing TQUERY/signature binding, review class, authority references, logical axes, proposed architecture dependencies, and unresolved axes.

Logical query scope, result, ordering, pagination, readiness and authorization are reviewed independently of physical storage and backend mechanics; a target query is never reduced to a generic repository or Firestore-shaped operation.
Identity-bootstrap, Account-catalog, Project-workspace, Inventory and multi-domain labels are proposed architecture dependencies only; they are not implemented or authorized Sync Stream assignments.
Postgres physical access and index design is globally deferred under A-003 and receives no per-query physical identity, name, key, index class, SQL, plan, or implementation claim in this slice.
Local physical access and index design is globally deferred under A-004 and receives no per-query physical identity, name, key, index class, SQLite definition, or implementation claim in this slice.
Each logical row binds the exact generated TQUERY and signature, uses discriminated reviewed, not-defined, or decision-blocked axes, and cannot populate a value for a blocked or undefined axis.
The logical-authority crosswalk consumes target TQUERY evidence without translating Firestore syntax, copying Firestore indexes, or claiming parity with any source query occurrence.

A separate downstream slice must reconcile all 386 generated QUERY source occurrences to retained target authority, a future target contract, source-only tooling, deliberate retirement, or an explicit hold; this slice does none of that reconciliation.

The future JSON-only validator deterministically rejects only structural faults: stale binding, missing/duplicate/orphan rows, unknown keys, invalid types or exact enums, invalid discriminated-axis shapes, non-allowlisted IDs/references, and non-deterministic output. It performs no free-text keyword or semantic inference; correctness of each logical statement remains mandatory human review evidence.

READY, implementation and promotion use exact allowlists, preserve all 16 query-owner surfaces plus FILE-063B0E6EC659 and MAN-INDEX-001 at their existing lifecycle state, path-exclude both logical-authority control leaves from generic Firebase audit/repair discovery, exact-path-exclude the logical-authority test fixture from current-source query candidate inspection, preserve the 386 QUERY inventory, and never confuse structural validation with semantic approval.

items: The reviewed registry contains exactly one row for each of the 18 generated TQUERY methods and no extra row.

Each row records exact signature binding, review class, authority references, six logical axes, proposed architecture dependencies and explicit unresolved axes without repeating generated owner/protocol/selector/category/path data.
Only a reviewed axis carries value. A not_defined_by_current_contract axis carries authorityRefs, and a decision_blocked axis carries blockerIds; the latter two forbid value.

Exact reviewClass values are mapped, mapped_with_unresolved_axes and decision_blocked; exact authority roles are canonical_target, architecture_authority, conversion_control and verification_evidence; exact logical-axis states are reviewed, not_defined_by_current_contract and decision_blocked; proposedDataDomains accepts only state proposed_architecture_dependency.

Exact decision/blocker allowlist is A-003, A-004, A-007, A-010, A-015, A-016, O-007, O-015, O-026 and O-040. The validator checks membership only, plus referenced path/exact-heading existence; it does not parse Markdown decision status or meaning.

Exact data-domain values are identity_bootstrap, account_catalog, project_workspace, project_workspace_or_inventory_by_immutable_scope, derived_from_project_directory_without_separate_canonical_authority, multi_domain_local_journal_and_authoritative_outcomes and multi_domain_identity_project_inventory_and_local_journal.

Exact unresolved-axis names are occurrence_and_provenance_persistence, deterministic_storage_order, exact_visibility_download_capability, canonical_directory_order, contribution_source_eligibility_and_taxonomy, authorization_merge_and_domain_routing, optimistic_projection_representation_if_required, issuer_subject_to_principal_resolution, offline_unlock_and_revocation_window, feature_retention_target_stream_authorization_and_migration and project_workspace_dependency_if_retained.
The exact physicalPlanes object is postgres {status: deferred, decision: A-003} and local {status: deferred, decision: A-004}; physical-plane fields are global and never present on a row.

The upstream inventory is itself closed and re-derived: exact generator/source root, protocol/method schemas and ordering, unique owners/protocols/methods, protocol-method joins/counts, selector-derived category, signature hash, TQUERY identity, digest and all totals must agree before registry validation.

Review classes are structural: mapped requires all six logical axes reviewed and no unresolved axes; mapped_with_unresolved_axes requires at least one non-reviewed logical axis or unresolved axis; decision_blocked requires at least one blocked logical or unresolved axis.
Future generated output derives TACCESS- plus the first 12 uppercase hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over UTF-8 target-query-logical-authority-v1\0<TQUERY-ID>, with collision rejection.

Future mappingHash is the lowercase full SHA-256 of UTF-8 target-query-logical-authority-mapping-v1\0 followed by canonical minified JSON of the registry row, recursively sorting object keys lexicographically while preserving array order. Neither ID nor hash is hand-authored in the registry.

Closed schema rejects every unknown key. Explicit forbidden examples include ownerSurfaceId, ownerPath, protocol, selector, category, tindexId, indexId, indexName, primaryKeyCandidate, secondaryRequired, physicalAccess, sql, rls, syncStream and provider; rejection is by key/schema or exact enum only, never by scanning free-text values for those words.

Repository root, inventory, registry, authority references, artifact and artifact parent are realpath-contained. Inputs and existing artifacts must be regular non-symlink files and path components may not traverse symlinks. Generate uses an unpredictable same-directory temporary file created exclusively with wx and O_NOFOLLOW where available, then atomically renames and cleans only its own temporary file.
All row-derived nested objects are reconstructed in canonical key order while preserving array order; CLI execution accepts exactly one generate or check argument.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: A-003 remains proposed and this logical-authority slice defines no table, column, relationship, constraint, view, physical access path or index.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No query handler, RPC, command, transaction, lock or server projection is implemented.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No Data API schema, relation, function or grant is introduced.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Authorization axes describe reviewed logical requirements or explicit uncertainty only; no RLS predicate or policy is selected or implemented.

syncStreams.notApplicable: All domain labels are proposed_architecture_dependency values only. No PowerSync query, parameter, stream assignment, table visibility or authorization is approved or implemented.

items: Readiness/completeness axes preserve each verified query contract's distinction between locally usable evidence and authoritative absence.
A-004 remains proposed, so no SQLite schema, query, collation, index, encryption or physical durability mechanism is claimed.

storageMedia.notApplicable: No media reference, bytes, Storage policy or attachment lifecycle is part of this logical registry.

appMcp.notApplicable: No app or MCP entry point is changed and no server endpoint is inferred from a Swift watch port.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: The 386 QUERY source-occurrence reconciliation is a separate downstream slice. No source query or Firebase index is mapped, transformed, retired or claimed equivalent here.

items: Implementation exposes dependency-free generate/check/test commands for one deterministic JSON audit; check byte-compares without writing and the CLI accepts exactly one mode argument.
Machine validation proves structural completeness and freshness only. Evidence separately records human review of logical meaning and every blocked/undefined axis.

READY changes only the reviewed JSON registry, two comment-only scaffolds, dossier/evidence/control metadata, the bounded discoverTooling exclusion plus deliberate discoverer re-acknowledgment, and one exact-path current-query extractor exclusion plus deliberate FILE-49BE7A26CE03 re-acknowledgment. The implementation test retains contiguous firestoreQuery and firestoreIndex negative cases so normal discovery proves both exclusions instead of relying on content evasion; generated QUERY artifacts and their 386 occurrences remain unchanged.

Implementation may replace the two scaffolds, add only target-query-logical-authority-crosswalk.generated.json, exact package commands and the Ubuntu conversion-control hook, plus synchronized control metadata.
Promotion is documentation/control-only after immutable implementation CI and human review. Reverting this control changes no runtime, provider or production behavior.

verification.expected: Exact set equality proves one closed-schema registry row for each of 18 current TQUERY methods, with exact inventory digest and signature binding and no copied generated ownership fields.

Closed JSON schema and discriminated unions reject unknown keys/types/enums, blocked-or-undefined axes with values, reviewed axes without values, missing authority/blocker references, duplicate/orphan rows, stale signatures and structurally inconsistent review classes including count-preserving swaps.

The exact global physicalPlanes object and proposed_architecture_dependency state/value enums pass. Unknown per-row fields—including explicit physical/index/SQL/RLS/Sync/provider keys—reject through closed-schema key validation; free-text values are never keyword-scanned.

Authority paths and exact literal headings exist; decision/blocker IDs belong to the frozen exact allowlist without parsing Markdown decision status; TACCESS follows its exact domain-separated hash formula; mappingHash follows the exact domain separator plus canonical-minified-registry-row formula; identity collisions reject.

Exact review-class, authority-role, logical-axis-state, proposed-data-domain, unresolved-axis-name and decision/blocker-ID allowlists reject any other token. The validator does not infer or approve a token's semantic placement within a row; human review owns that judgment.

Closed row schema rejects sourceQueryIds, firestoreQuery, firestoreIndex and other unknown source/physical mapping keys. It does not scan free-text for Firebase or index words; evidence and exact-diff review preserve the separate downstream 386-occurrence reconciliation boundary.

verification.owner: conversion control and exact diff review
verification.expected: Exact READY, implementation and promotion allowlists pass; both logical-authority leaves remain CONFIG-only and the 386-occurrence query inventory remains current/unchanged with contiguous firestoreQuery/firestoreIndex implementation tests; FILE-49BE7A26CE03 is deliberately re-acknowledged without status/owner change; all 16 query owners, FILE-063B0E6EC659, MAN-INDEX-001 and existing package/workflow surfaces preserve status and ownership.

verification.owner: Ubuntu conversion-control CI and human registry/generated-diff review
verification.expected: Immutable READY CI passes comment-only scaffolds and synchronized controls; later implementation CI structurally checks deterministic JSON before target Swift work while evidence separately records human semantic review.

Registry validation and generated JSON bytes are deterministic across fresh processes, nested object-key permutations and repeated generate/check runs while array order remains meaningful; no runtime cache or provider state changes the result.

Missing/stale input, set/signature/derived-inventory mismatch, unknown keys, invalid types/enums, invalid discriminated unions, non-allowlisted references, symlink/root escape and unsafe artifact/temp paths fail deterministically without network fallback or artifact overwrite. Extra CLI arguments fail. Semantic contradictions in otherwise valid free text remain human-review failures, not machine claims.

notes: Implemented locally after amended immutable READY commit fcfaec8397f08b17ef54e9cffc651dfa3fce2b6a passed Actions run 33849974363. The dependency-free JSON-only generator/checker and 23-test adversarial suite bind all 18 current TQUERY methods to the reviewed registry, re-derive all upstream inventory relationships/hashes/totals, enforce review-class consistency, canonicalize nested output, enforce realpath/non-symlink inputs and safe exclusive atomic artifact generation, derive collision-checked TACCESS identities and mapping hashes, and emit one deterministic generated JSON artifact. The committed READY addendum preserves genuine path exclusions for generic Firebase-tool and current-query discovery while the implementation tests retain contiguous forbidden-key cases and the 386 QUERY inventory remains unchanged. TQUERYAUTH-TEST-001 through -007 and -009 through -010 pass locally; TEST-008 remains planned until immutable implementation CI, while human review of all 18 generated rows is recorded separately in evidence. The validator is structural only and cannot approve free-text meaning. A-003/A-004 and every existing query owner remain unadvanced.
